name: Blazing Critical (Combat, Critical)
body:
Your critical hits with fire attacks set foes on fire.

Prerequisite: Critical Focus, BAB +9.

Benefit: When you score a critical hit with an attack that deals fire damage, the target catches on fire, taking 1d6 points of fire damage each round until extinguished. While the target is on fire, and for 1d6 rounds afterward, the target illuminates the area around it like a torch.

Special: You can apply the effects of only one critical feat to a given critical hit unless you possess Critical Mastery.
